pack.title: PHOTOGRAPHY · MANUAL CONTROL: evidence-locked study guide
pack.overview: This guide organizes 19 source statements from 1 image. Answers preserve the extracted wording so each statement can be checked against its source.

sources.extractedText:
PHOTOGRAPHY · MANUAL CONTROL
Mastering exposure
Shape brightness, motion, and depth with three connected controls.

Aperture
Lens opening
Wider: more light, shallower depth.
Narrower: less light, deeper depth.

Shutter speed
Exposure time
Faster: less light, freezes motion.
Slower: more light, shows motion blur.

ISO
Signal amplification
Higher: brighter, more visible noise.
Lower: less noise, needs more light.

One scene. Three decisions.
Choose the look first, then balance the remaining controls.

EXPOSURE THINKING Pick the creative priority
Meter the scene
Balance the other controls

deepLessons.learningObjective: Explain the supplied source statements about Aperture without adding outside information.
deepLessons.directAnswer: Wider: more light, shallower depth. Narrower: less light, deeper depth.
deepLessons.explanation: The source gives 2 evidence statements for this lesson. It states: “Wider: more light, shallower depth.” It also states: “Narrower: less light, deeper depth.” These statements are the supported answer. Keep their wording in view while you compare them, and do not add a cause, purpose, or mechanism unless another source states it.
